---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with a scraper or the library
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Module / source affected**
Which module or source is affected (e.g. a specific scraper module, cache, security helpers, exports).

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Actual behavior**
What actually happened, including the full error message / stack trace.

**Code snippet / reproduction**
```js
// Minimal reproduction — what you called and with which options.
```

**Environment**
- Node.js version: (e.g. 20.11)
- Runtime: Node / Bun / Deno / serverless (Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, ...)
- Package version or commit: (e.g. v1.0.0 / main@abc123)

**Additional context**
Logs, network error (`fetch failed`, HTTP status), or anything else that helps reproduce.

> Note: source sites change their markup/APIs frequently. If a scraper stopped working, mention whether it worked before and when it started failing.
